title: MARKETS IN DARWIN
style: Style: Upbeat acoustic pop, handclaps, festival energy
lyrics:
[Intro — crowd ambience, guitar strum]

One, two… breathe in… sing out…

[Verse 1]

Sunrise on a market street
Barefoot rhythm, summer heat
Guitar case by her side
Dreams too big to hide

[Verse 2]

Quiet smile, gentle tone
Then she claims the microphone
Butter wouldn’t melt, they say
Till she owns the stage her way

[Pre-Chorus]

Feel it rise, feel it grow
Every heart already knows

[Chorus]

From shy to strong in one song
She’s been magic all along
Darwin skies, open air
Every voice is in her care

[Bridge — Spanish chant]

Vamos, canta sin temor
Sing with heart, sing with soul

[Final Chorus]
[Outro]

Clap it out… fade it down…
